newsitem.title: USA: Nitinol Medical buys Image Tech stock.
newsitem.headline: Nitinol Medical buys Image Tech stock.

text.p: Nitinol Medical Technologies Inc said on Friday that it had bought $2.3 million of preferred stock in privately held Image Technologies Corp.

In a statement, Nitinol said Image Technologies is developing a line of advanced imaging products for minimally invasive surgery. As the commercial feasibility of the technology is uncertain, Nitinol intends to charge the amount of its investment, including expenses, to operations as in-process research and development, it said.

Under the terms of the agreement, Nitinol Medical owns 23 percent of Image Technologies. Further, Nitinol Medical has extended to Image Technologies a line of up to $2.0 million of senior debt, the company said.
Nitinol Medical Technologies Inc designs, develops, and markets medical devices that are delivered by minimally invasive procedures.
